h:
The line in the sand: either you reject the New Testament and cling to the modern Israel narrative, or you believe it — and face what the text actually says.

The state called “Israel” today is one of the most brilliant deceptions in spiritual history, a Babylonian counterfeit that has hijacked the prophetic narrative and misdirected the entire Western church.

THE BIBLICAL DEFINITION OF ISRAEL HAS BEEN FULFILLED

The New Testament is shockingly clear about who the true Israel is:

“For neither circumcision counts for anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation. And as for all who walk by this rule, peace and mercy be upon them, and upon the Israel of God.” (Galatians 6:15-16)

“For no one is a Jew who is merely one outwardly, nor is circumcision outward and physical. But a Jew is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the letter.” (Romans 2:28-29)

The “Israel of God” is the global Church, Jew and Gentile alike in Messiah. The true mark of Israel is circumcision of the heart, not genetic descent.

THE MODERN STATE REJECTS THE KING OF ISRAEL

The fundamental, undeniable truth:

  • Biblical Israel’s identity was rooted in covenant relationship with God
  • Modern Israel is a secular state where the overwhelming majority reject Jesus as Messiah

How can a nation be “God’s chosen people” when it systematically rejects God’s chosen King? This is the ultimate inversion, worshipping the promise while rejecting the Promised One.

THE PROPHECIES POINT TO MESSIAH, NOT A POLITICAL STATE

The Old Testament prophecies about Israel’s restoration find their ultimate fulfillment in Jesus and His international Church:

  • The promise to Abraham about blessing “all nations” (Genesis 12:3) → fulfilled through the Great Commission
  • The new covenant with “the house of Israel” (Jeremiah 31:31) → established in Jesus’ blood for all believers
  • The rebuilding of “David’s fallen tent” (Amos 9:11) → fulfilled in Christ’s resurrection and the Church

THE ZION DECEPTION

While the West obsesses over Jerusalem, the true Zion has been preserved elsewhere.

The focus on the modern state is a deliberate misdirection to keep you from discovering the preserved truths outside the Roman/Babylonian system.

THE REMNANT’S POSITION

We affirm:

  1. God still has a plan for Jewish people, salvation through Jesus Christ (Romans 11:23-26)
  2. The true Israel is the global Body of Messiah
  3. Our hope is Christ’s return to the true Zion, not political support for any nation-state

Stop following the map Babylon gave you. The promise was never about dirt, it was about the King who would rule all nations.

The state of Israel is a geopolitical entity. The Israel of God is a spiritual reality. Confusing the two is accepting Babylon’s greatest deception.
